draft.headline: White House Launches 'Trump TV' Feed After Major Networks Boycott Press Pool
draft.body: Fox News joined other major outlets in boycotting the White House press pool. In response, ABC, CBS, CNN, Fox and NBC issued statements that no administration should restrict a news organization because it objects to its reporting. After ABC, CBS, Fox News and NBC declined to participate in the pool, the White House promoted its own 'Trump TV' feed. The sequence of events shows a direct link between the networks' refusal to join the pool and the administration's decision to create an alternative distribution channel.

post.text: The White House launched a “Trump TV” feed after Fox News, ABC, CBS, CNN and NBC boycotted its press pool. The networks said no administration should restrict a news organization because it objects to its reporting.
